notes: ITDP Atlas of Sustainable City Transport, GitHub release update_2024 of https://github.com/ITDP/atlas (asset published 2025-01-10); indicators for the 2024 data year computed by ITDP from OpenStreetMap, GHS-POP R2023A, Mobility Database GTFS and Transit Explorer. Values are ITDP's, copied (fractions x100 -> %), not recomputed.
Atlas agglomerations are GHS-UCDB R2024A urban centres (hdc == ID_UC_G0); each match is verified geometrically, accepted only if IoU >= 0.5 (see detail.iou / detail.area_ratio).

License: ODbL 1.0 (database) + DbCL 1.0 (contents) - https://atlas.itdp.org/about/about_data.html. Attribution: Atlas of Sustainable City Transport, ITDP (Reich & Braga 2024), atlas.itdp.org, data release update_2024, ODbL 1.0; contains information from OpenStreetMap © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), GHSL (European Commission JRC, CC BY 4.0), Mobility Database GTFS feeds, Transit Explorer.
quality=observed means 'computed indicator taken as published by ITDP' (method: network isochrones on OSM + GHSL population); OSM completeness varies by country - see etl/notes/itdp-atlas.md.
